ns0:svg.ns0:title: Namekian Energy Absorption

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
Prevent all but 2 life cards of damage from an
energy attack. Your MP gains 1 stage for each
life card of base damage that attack would deal.
